S6 curated family lane (rpt_attribution_filer_resolution_and_group_family B4, landed 2026-11-12): git-tracked seeds for corporate families inside the group hyperedge family. Labels are namespaced family:<name> so they cannot collide with the disclosure-scope RPT lane (vigil:rpt:<SYMBOL>) or the curated $.group dyad sets (bare names). Members must resolve to stored entities — unknown names are dropped at derive time with a printed warning, never minted. Seeded 2026-11-12 from the live $.group dyad sets; curation grows by editing this file (a removed family is pruned from the store on the next derive). v2 (2026-11-12, operator mode-1 core-only blessing): each measured family grows by the members declared by >=2 distinct filers (review_sheet unions) plus the ruled Hinduja Automotive fact; Tata 5->233, Adani 2->24, Bajaj 2->17, Hinduja 3->4. v3 (2026-11-12, operator: add Adani anchors Ambuja Cement/ACC/New Delhi Television and keep the anchor-declared members): Adani 24->66 = core(filers>=2) 30 + anchor-declared 43 + curated 24 (overlap-collapsed); anchor-only adds incl ACC Concrete South/West, ACC Mineral Resources, Orient Cement, Holderind Investments, Endeavour Trade And Investment, Ambuja Concrete North/West.
v4 (2026-11-12): removed 3 dead Tata spellings ('THE TATA POWER COMPANY', 'Tata Power Company', 'The Indian Hotels Company') — unresolvable since earlier dedup passes; their intended targets ('Tata Power', 'Indian Hotels') are already members, so membership is unchanged (233 -> 230 lines, 0 resolved members lost). v5 (2026-11-12, name_token_family_seed_lane S2 first apply): 6 new families from the S1 candidate generator's edge-verified complete families — Godrej (4), ICICI (4), Raymond (3), JSW (5, all under vigil:rpt:JS RPT disclosure), Welspun (3, cross-linked via Welspun Living + WELENT/WELCORP disclosures), Aarti (3, Industries hub already same_group with both others). Excluded on evidence: Shriram (polysemy — DCM Shriram persons-cluster vs Shriram Finance corporate-cluster vs Shriram Pistons SPR cluster are three distinct groups; no cross-edges), Samsung/Oracle (foreign non-promoter), Max (Healthcare leg edge-less).
v6 (2026-11-12, group_discovery_scale_lane S2 first apply): 16 new families from the component-inventory triage (657 weak components over 13,233 company-company same_group dyads; first wave = clean single-filer components, ref share >=0.90, <=2 sectors, no cross-family merge flags): DLF (213), HCLTECH (130), MOTHERSON (179), EMBDL (187), GVT&D (110), ENTERO (106), PRESTIGE (102), APOLLOHOSP (90), MANKIND (73), ASHOKA (83), MPHASIS (71), REDINGTON (78), HGINFRA (65), MASTEK (59), HINDUNILVR (61), COLPAL (51). Members = companies disclosed under the single vigil:rpt:<SYMBOL> ref dominating each component (entity_type='company' only); sorted canonical names.
v7 (2026-11-12, group_discovery_scale_lane S2 second apply): 9 new families + 2 extensions from the blob-decomposition triage (5 largest dyad components split into label-clusters by shared-member overlap >=10; core = members appearing in >=2 RPT labels of the cluster, plus name-token matches within the cluster labels): Mahindra (64), Bharti (29), Vedanta (18), Reliance (67), SP Group (43, Afcons+Sterling & Wilson), Torrent (48), Max (19), Jubilant (41), Leela (5).
